name: 20165 · Sterling, VA
findings: ZIP 20165 (Sterling) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20165 (Sterling) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20165 (Sterling) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
